editorial.blurb: A beloved Chicago institution for over 50 years, El Presidente delivers authentic Mexican flavors in a casual, welcoming atmosphere with an excellent patio and a homemade hot sauce that keeps regulars coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early for a quieter experience, come in summer to enjoy the wonderful outdoor patio, and bring your own bottle since they're BYOB—don't miss the homemade hot sauce on every table.
